text:
You're right — that's a gap. The "All workspaces" view never got the waiting treatment.

**Root cause:** `WorkspaceCard` itself already supports the grey waiting dot (precedence running > unread > waiting), but `AllWorkspacesCard.svelte` only passes `isRunning` and `isUnread` at all four of its call sites (recents, recent view, repo-grouped, status-grouped) — it never passes `isWaiting`. Only the Active card's dedicated Waiting section sets it. So a workspace that is idle-with-waiting (or in-progress-with-waiting, like your screenshot) shows no dot in the All list:

````svelte path=packages/cloudlands-fe/src/lib/components/layout/sidebar-nav/cards/AllWorkspacesCard.svelte mode=EXCERPT
<WorkspaceCard
  {workspace}
  variant="compact"
  isRunning={_isRunning(workspace)}
  isUnread={_isUnread(workspace)}
````

**Fix delegated:** I added a task to the spec and delegated it — pass `isWaiting={workspace.waiting === true}` at every `WorkspaceCard` call site in `AllWorkspacesCard` (and check `ChatWorkspaceCard` for the same gap), with unit tests covering the dot in the All view and the running/unread precedence. The implementor will file a cloudlands-fe PR, spawn a reviewer, and report back green — I'll merge it and it rides the next hourly alpha.

One note on your screenshot: if that row's workspace has a *running* agent, the daemon reports `in_progress` and the dot should be the green pulse (running wins over waiting) — but either way, today the All view drops the waiting dot entirely, which is the bug being fixed. Ending my turn to wait for the fix PR.
